description: This file defines functions and constants for handling media-related actions in a node-based system, including capturing camera snapshots, recording screen videos, and retrieving latest photos. It interfaces with external modules for media processing and gateway communication.

methods.name: executeNodeMediaAction
methods.description: Dispatches media actions such as camera snap, photo retrieval, camera clip, and screen recording based on input parameters.

methods.name: executeCameraSnap
methods.description: Captures a snapshot from a specified camera node, saves the image to a temporary path, and optionally returns image data if modelHasVision is true.

methods.name: executePhotosLatest
methods.description: Retrieves the latest photos from a node, saves them to temporary files, and optionally returns image data.

methods.name: executeCameraClip
methods.description: Records a video clip from a camera node with specified parameters and saves it to a file.

methods.name: executeScreenRecord
methods.description: Records a screen video for a specified duration and saves it to a file.

methods.name: requireString
methods.description: Utility function to ensure a parameter is a non-empty string.
